name: koya_lump
desc: The dog man has completely melted down: replace the whole character with a shapeless, heaving mass of the same glossy brown paint with cream swirls, rising from a wide puddle on the floor at the same spot: a slim, tall, narrow column-like mound about 60 percent of his height and about as wide as his slim body, with a small extra bulge on the right side behind it, with many thin drips and sticky strands. No head, no face, no arms, no shoulders, no legs, no body shapes at all, just thick sticky goo welling up, bubbles swelling and popping, sticky strands. Same colors, outline and pixel art style.
